description: This PHP source file defines the AutoScalingClient class, which serves as a client interface for interacting with AWS Auto Scaling services. It declares various methods for managing auto scaling groups, launch configurations, policies, and other related resources, utilizing PHPDoc annotations for method signatures and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: AutoScalingClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Auto Scaling API operations.

methods.name: attachInstances
methods.description: Attaches EC2 instances to an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: attachInstancesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attaches EC2 instances to an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: createAutoScalingGroup
methods.description: Creates a new Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: createAutoScalingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: deleteAutoScalingGroup
methods.description: Deletes a specified Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: deleteAutoScalingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a specified Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: describeAutoScalingGroups
methods.description: Returns details about Auto Scaling groups.

methods.name: describeAutoScalingGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about Auto Scaling groups.

methods.name: updateAutoScalingGroup
methods.description: Updates the configuration for an existing Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: updateAutoScalingGroupAsync
